confirmedObservation: The fixed Web resume receipt checks paused=false, exact revision increment, and the shape/state of any promoted item, but does not bind an absent promotion to the expected task or a present promotion to current task/turn/item. The fixed interaction implementation does these semantic checks. This corroborates the GO/Original input, not a separately discovered task.

designSeam.responsibility: A browser-safe, pure validator of an immutable pause/resume response against the original frozen request. Reuse from the existing two consumers.
outsideResponsibility: Transport, FlowClient calls, retry scheduling and refreshing current queue state
Web recovery journal, private persistence/checkpoint representation and user-facing messages
designSeam.integrationCaution: Select a supported browser-safe package entry when the shared owner takes the existing task; do not deep-import an unexported path or pull the whole interaction controller into Web. Current package exports do not expose queue-control. No export or contract changes are made by this review.

targetedRegressionMatrix.case: promoted=null and current task differs from expectedTaskId, including expectedTaskId=null
targetedRegressionMatrix.expect: Reject immutable receipt; Web keeps original key/body in UNKNOWN; no automatic rewrite or resend.

targetedRegressionMatrix.case: promoted exists but taskId, turnId, turnNumber or queueItemId disagrees with currentTurn
targetedRegressionMatrix.expect: Reject each identity mismatch before an accepted checkpoint.

targetedRegressionMatrix.case: Valid historical replay receipt while refreshed queue has since advanced
targetedRegressionMatrix.expect: Accept the original immutable receipt and refresh current facts separately; never compare replay ACK to latest mutable state.

targetedRegressionMatrix.case: Valid no-promotion resume with unchanged expected task; valid bound promotion; allowed pause revision delta 0 or 1
targetedRegressionMatrix.expect: Preserve both consumers existing successful behavior and explicit retry identity.

targetedRegressionMatrix.case: Transport failure followed by malformed or contradictory response on explicit retry
targetedRegressionMatrix.expect: Retain the original request/key, mark UNKNOWN, do not clear unresolved state or persist an accepted checkpoint.

scope: Existing TUI001-06/08 and MATURE06 successor, queued after personal publication/default-host diagnosis; Original owns shared-rule coordination; Web owns only its consumer changes after exact scope take. No parallel queue writer.

limitations: No dynamic reproduction or test pass is claimed.
